CAPTURE WARNING. The Commission's conclusion runs in two halves: the captain as pilot-in-command bears responsibility for the decision, AND it is equally clear that the air transportation system failed him by placing him in a situation without the tools to decide properly. Capturing only the first half reverses the meaning of the inquiry most celebrated for refusing individual-blame findings. Take both halves or neither. Source is cite-only, so this may end as attributed summary. Verified 18 August 2026.
